name: Eschweiler (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of black, yellow and blue, charged at the centre with the city arms of Eschweiler (a black lion on yellow beneath a red mural crown).
history: The city received approval to bear its arms on 13 December 1880; the city colours and flag follow the arms in black, yellow and blue.

features.role: Eschweiler arms — black lion on yellow with mural crown
